capabilities: compose a message under a ## Vestaboard heading and send it to the board
preview the message as Vestaboard tiles in a live sidebar view
validate and auto-fix messages for unsupported characters and row limits
send via the Vestaboard Cloud API or the LAN Local API
log each send in a Vestaboard History table in the note
extras: Beta status with limited testing against physical boards; desktop only; install via BRAT recommended while in beta; API keys stored in plaintext in data.json inside the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no way to compose and transmit messages to a Vestaboard split-flap display from within a note.

requires.name: Cloud Read/Write API key or Local API key
web.vestaboard.com account for cloud key setup

summary: Vestaboard integration that sends a message written in a note to a Vestaboard split-flap display, with live tile preview, validation, and a send history table.
